# LogicSwitch:minDuration

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the logic switch min duration.

```lua
local minDuration = ls:minDuration([minDuration])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `minDuration` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

minDuration (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
ls = model.getLogicSwitch(0)
ls:minDuration(100)
```
